title_en: Fall 2026 Master's Thesis Defense Public Presentation Schedule, Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering
summary: This notice from the Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering announces the public presentation schedule for Fall 2026 master's thesis defenses. Only the title was available for translation, so the schedule, location and any instructions were not read. Students should consult the original notice or contact the department office; contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
Title: Fall 2026 (2026-2) Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering Master's Thesis Defense Public Presentation Schedule Notice

Posted: 2026-11-25

Note from the translator: Only the title of this notice was provided. The body of the notice, including the presentation schedule and any attachments, was not available and was not read. Please refer to the original notice or contact the department office for the schedule; contact details are in the original notice.
